archetypes.name: Street Samurai
archetypes.notes: High physical stats, heavy cyberware (Wired Reflexes, Smartlink, Muscle Replacement). Resources priority used to fund cyberware. Canonical example: Bodyguard (p.49), Street Samurai (p.57), Merc (p.60).

archetypes.name: Mage
archetypes.notes: Hermetic mage. Priority A to Magic (human). High Willpower and Intelligence. Minimal gear; spends Force Points on combat and detection spells. Canonical example: Combat Mage (p.52), Mage (p.58).

archetypes.name: Shaman
archetypes.notes: Shamanic mage. High Charisma (governs spirit summoning drain) and Willpower. Avoids cyberware. Must select a totem. Canonical example: Shaman (p.62), Shaman variant (p.65).

archetypes.name: Physical Adept
archetypes.notes: Magic B (human) or C (meta). No cyberware — Essence loss cuts Magic. Adept powers supplement physical stats. Canonical example: Street Shaman adept (p.64).

archetypes.name: Decker
archetypes.notes: Very high Intelligence. Resources buy a quality cyberdeck (Fuchi Cyber-4 or better). Datajack essential. High Hacking Pool. Canonical example: Decker (p.53), Elf Decker (p.56).

archetypes.name: Rigger
archetypes.notes: High Intelligence and vehicle skills. Vehicle Control Rig essential; Datajack required. Resources priority funds the VCR and drones. Canonical example: Rigger (p.61).

archetypes.name: Face
archetypes.notes: Very high Charisma and Intelligence. Wide contact network (6+ contacts). No cyberware in canonical build. Canonical example: Face (p.54).

archetypes.name: Combat Mage
archetypes.notes: Offensive spell focus (Mana Bolt, Powerball, Sleep). High Willpower for drain resistance. Thermographic cybereyes acceptable. Canonical example: Combat Mage (p.52).

archetypes.name: Investigator
archetypes.notes: High Intelligence and Charisma. Broad skill set for information gathering. Wide contacts. Street Samurai Catalog: micro-recorder, pocket secretary. Canonical example: Investigator (p.54).
